predecessor_protocol.cause: provider response schema used const without an explicit string type
predecessor_protocol.reason_for_new_protocol: No model-authored result existed, so the invalid transport protocol could not measure the independent variable. The failed protocol remains disclosed and is not mixed with v1.

hypothesis: A short stable mission and downstream-consumer context improves same-policy semantic-domain grouping without answer leakage.

independent_variable.variant_a: base prompt plus shared input only
independent_variable.variant_b: identical base prompt plus the frozen mission-context block plus identical shared input

provider_response_format_reason: Strict JSON is observable authoring behavior and is checked after freeze against the same candidate contract for both variants; no provider schema can mask or create a variant difference.

budget.reason: Three calls per variant is the smallest allowed budget that exposes within-variant stability rather than one-pair noise.

hard_validation: one strict JSON object conforming to the frozen post-response schema
one identical closed policy per domain
no invented or overclaimed component contract
no executable rules, workflow or case-time behavior

blinded_consumer_fit_review.candidate_order: ascending candidate SHA-256 with aliases R1 through R6
questions: Can one scope-resolver applicability decision honestly apply or not apply the whole domain?
Does applicability activate one coherent typed component family?
Does the merge force meanings with independently different life states to activate together?
Has one coherent domain been split merely because obligations are separate sentences?
Is the boundary target-independent rather than section, appendix, XML or PDF driven?

verdict_rule.MISSION_CONTEXT_HELPFUL: Variant B hard-pass rate is not lower, its median total consumer-fit defect count is lower, and it introduces no recurring new defect category in at least two B candidates.
verdict_rule.MISSION_CONTEXT_HARMFUL: Variant B hard-pass rate is lower, its median total consumer-fit defect count is higher, or a new target-layout or invented-execution defect recurs in at least two B candidates.
verdict_rule.MISSION_CONTEXT_NEUTRAL: Neither the helpful nor harmful rule is met; small or one-off differences are treated as noise.

scope_stops: no corrected G5.28 trial or Definition publication
no G5.29, Scope Resolver or runtime change
no new capability, Tax Model, Declaration Model, tax calculation, XML or PDF implementation
